comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected into world space via Road.project(). trigger_radius is in compressed-world meters. Entries marked needs_owner_review require the owner's lived knowledge to confirm placement and note. Route order: Norman Manley Airport → Palisadoes → Harbour View → Kingston → Spanish Town → Bog Walk → Linstead → Moneague → Faith's Pen → Fern Gully → Ocho Rios.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The iconic sand spit — sea on both sides, mountains rising ahead

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Junction where the Palisadoes meets the mainland — the roundabout

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial area along Windward Road, Kingston

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Kingston East community along Windward Road

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Kingston neighbourhood along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Vineyard Town
communities.note: Central Kingston community

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's business district — Emancipation Park, hotels, offices

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Heart of uptown Kingston — the 1813 clock tower, Constant Spring Road junction

communities.name: Dunrobin
communities.note: Residential area along Hagley Park Road heading west

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's old capital — founded by the Spanish in 1534, today a major city

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: Community just west of Spanish Town

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: First free village in Jamaica, established 1835 — hilltop community

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the gorge — where the Rio Cobre cuts through the limestone hills

communities.name: Kitson Town
communities.note: Small community along the river valley road

communities.name: Riversdale
communities.note: River Road community in the Bog Walk valley

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: "Carry mi ackee go a Linstead market" — the song town, famous for its Saturday market

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine bauxite junction town

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: High hill country between Linstead and Moneague — the wrong-turn zone

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads town in the interior hills — where the route turns toward the north coast

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. Don't you dare drive past.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Spectacular tree-fern canopy road — one of Jamaica's most photographed stretches

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Ochi — the tourist capital of the north coast, home to Dunn's River Falls
